Overview

Nyaraka means "documents" in Swahili. It opens Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, PDF, Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON, RTF and plain text files, keeps a private copy of each in its own library, and converts between formats. Files arrive through Android's Open with and Share, and it reads Arabic, Hebrew, Chinese, Hindi and Amharic as well as it reads English.

  • 11kinds of file it opens
  • 9writing systems, right to left included
  • 1private library for everything
  • 0uploads: it all stays on the phone

What it does

01Opens almost anything

Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, PDF, Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON, RTF and text.

02Converts between formats

Turn a document into a PDF, a sheet into CSV, and more, without leaving the phone.

03Your own library

Every file you open is kept as a private copy, so it is there even after the original moves.

04Every script

Arabic and Hebrew read right to left, and Chinese, Thai or Amharic PDFs show every character.

05Open with and Share

Files come in from any app through Android's own menus.

06Offline

No account, no upload. Everything happens on the device.

For the technical reader

How it's built

  • Flutter
  • Dart
  • PDF
  • OOXML
  • Unicode
  1. Office files parsed straight from their XML inside the zip.
  2. PDF viewing with pdfrx, and PDF writing with fonts embedded for every script.
  3. Right-to-left layout handled at the paragraph level.
  4. Test documents in Arabic, Hindi and mixed scripts, checked on a real phone.
